label: Kimi K3.1 Pro
output:
**Some good news, an apology, and a change to our site visits.**

First, the good news: Priya Bhatia is joining us on **Monday 16 November**. Priya is a chartered structural engineer (IStructE) and has spent nine years with a consultancy in Coventry. I’m genuinely delighted she’s coming on board. If you see her on site, please do say hello and make her feel welcome.

I also want to be straightforward about the last two months. In September and October, our beam calculations and drawings were taking **5–6 weeks**. That was too long. Several clients waited far longer than they should have, some were understandably unhappy, and one left a sharp review. I’m sorry.

The slow turnaround was my fault: I said yes to too much work while trying to do it all myself. I was doing site visits during the day and calculations until midnight; my wife started calling the office “the other house”. That isn’t an excuse. One couple in Harborne had their builder waiting and the steel already ordered. We got what they needed to them in three days, but only after they had chased us twice. They shouldn’t have had to.

With Priya joining, we finally have the capacity to put this right. Our target for **beam calculations and drawings is now 10 working days**. If you’re currently waiting, please know that your job is moving. You’re very welcome to message me directly for an update.

There’s also a change to first site visits. **Visits taking place from 1 January 2027 will cost £95**, which will be deducted from your fee if you go ahead with us. **Any visit already booked when this post is published remains free, whatever date it takes place.**

I liked offering free visits, but around a third never turned into a job. This change will help us focus our time on delivering work properly for the clients who have commissioned us.

Thank you to everyone who has been patient, and to those who told us plainly when we fell short. I’m determined to do better — and very pleased to have Priya joining us as I do.
